ms.report:
----------------------------------------------
We thank you for all your constructive feedback. Thanks to reviewer 1 for approving it.
We are resubmitting revised POA for Milestone 1 based on reviewer 2 feedback. However we find some of the statement are not correct like "The platform, as you submitted, replicates functionality already offered by standard Visual Studio tools without providing any meaningful enhancement." This statement is not correct. We are developers and we have proposed it based on our own experience and other developers feedback that even basic support of Haskell and Plutus development in not available in VS Code.
We shall attempt to make Cardano development support within VS Code as sophisticated as possible. However we believe even the basic support of functionalities we listed in our proposal and integrating external tool in VS code can make huge positive impact on Cardano Development Ecosystem. And that is our proposal.
We agree that expecting innovation beyond what is listed in proposal is not wrong however the proposal is about enabling Cardano Developers with basic tools. You give example of Cardano-cli having feature like Switching between preprod, preview, and mainnet, yes, it is available in Cardano-CLI however not there in VS Code and that is key point. Our proposal is lot of developers use VS Code and the new developers using vs code want to start with Cardano, they don't find this feature within VS Code.
